title: C-DEVIL II SPORTFISHING Inc.

services.name: Fall Fishing
services.desc: Whether you're a seasoned angler chasing thrills or a curious novice ready to cast your first line, C-Devil Sportfishing caters to all adventurers, from families seeking memorable experiences to groups of friends looking for a challenge.Join us for a thrilling fishing adventure on the beautiful and bountiful waters of Block Island Sound that will leave you with memories (and photos!) to last a lifetime. Explore the diverse fish species available during different charter durations and seasons, and read booking details below. Our inshore fishing adventures start with a quick 7-mile run to the fishing grounds. Captain Kelly does his best to tailor the day on the water to suit your preferences
